input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Garman owns all IP in the Work including the Modifications and Improvements built for us under Schedule "D", and the only licence back (Section 2) is non-transferable, non-exclusive, limited to AS400s at Authorized Locations with extra fees elsewhere (p0028), expressly bars sublicensing (p0033), and is conditional on continuing fee payment under Section 17(a) (p0117). The escrow licence in p0115 is contingent on Garman default or discontinued support, so it does not cure this. That fails the fallback requirement for a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for our business. There is also no provision addressing our data, so we confirm any Garman licence in it is limited to processing solely to provide the services. We have kept Garman's ownership of its platform, tools and know-how intact.

proposal.summary: Add licence-back to Modifications/deliverables and limit any Garman licence in Sparkling's data
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Garman owns all IP in the Work including the Modifications we pay for, and our only licence is non-transferable, location-limited and conditional on continuing fees, so we have added our fallback licence-back to the Modifications and other work product created for us, carved that licence out of the sublicence prohibition in Section 3(c), and confirmed any Garman licence in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services.

ops.text: Garman grants Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense, for Sparkling's business, the Modifications and any other deliverables or work product created for Sparkling under this Agreement (the "Deliverables"). Any licence granted to Garman in Sparkling's data is limited to processing that data solely to provide the services under this Agreement.

ops.oldText: or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person
